min_supported_version.description: Force update if installed app version is below this semver (major.minor.patch).

latest_version.description: Optional update prompt when installed version is below this but at or above min_supported_version.

ios_store_url.description: App Store URL opened by the Update button on iOS. Replace with the real Tutorix App Store link before production.

android_store_url.description: Play Store URL opened by the Update button on Android. Replace with the real Tutorix Play Store link before production.

defaultValue.value: A required update is available. Please update Tutorix to continue.

force_update_message.description: Body copy on the blocking force-update screen.

defaultValue.value: A newer version of Tutorix is available. Update for the latest improvements.

optional_update_message.description: Body copy on the optional update modal.
